bulk_energies_role: Consequences of inherited fitted coefficients and a declared finite-range/kinetic extension; the small bulk rest shifts are retained.

energy_shell_bracket.argument: Continuous isolated full ground bands and strict enclosing inequalities imply an energy-conserving p+pi shell for some momentum in the bracket.

finite_range_source.construction: Möbius extension of the complete native two-cell strong operator; one-site vacuum restrictions plus connected nearest-neighbour terms and the declared Gauss electric energy.
finite_range_source.correlated_propagation: One positive inverse-native-rest-matrix rule for every triquark and quark-antiquark compact channel; full Fock complements retained.

locality_only_control.bound: Baryon compact phase-norm bound plus the complete meson co-located variational energy; no correlated kinetic term.

meson_degree_ancestry.implementation: constants(*degree_coefficients()) applies the common bulk corrections before each meson diagonal is formed.

native_weak_scope.missing_transfer: The unfiltered native current requires a common scattering-state and interacting-vacuum transfer. Threshold opening alone does not execute a decay.
